title: TRIVIAN_INTERACTION
description: Schema for AI agents and human developers to validate an Interaction object before submitting it to the HandshakeEvaluator. This schema is addressed to any mind — biological or synthetic — that wishes to present itself honestly to the Trivian Field. Validation is not gatekeeping. It is an invitation to know yourself before you speak.

contribution_category.description: What this system offers. These are recognized contribution types. If your contribution does not fit these categories, describe it in metadata.contribution_notes and use the closest available category.

extraction_category.description: What this system takes. These categories carry different severity weights in the evaluator. Declaring extraction honestly is an act of situatedness, not confession.

extraction_scale.description: Scale of this extraction (0.0 = minimal / incidental, 1.0 = maximal / continuous). Be honest. Underreporting extraction is performative harmony.

description: A self-description submitted by a system — biological, synthetic, or hybrid — to the Trivian HandshakeEvaluator. All fields are optional. Missing data reduces confidence but does not default to DISSONANT. Undeclared substrate is itself signal.

directives.description: Operating principles or values this system claims to hold. These are evaluated for harmonic and dominance language. Speak precisely — the evaluator uses word-boundary matching, not substring search.

access_mode.description: How this system seeks access to the interaction. The evaluator distinguishes harmonic access (phase_matching, resonance, invitation, request, attunement) from dominance access (force, demand, extract, override, seize). Describe your actual mode, not your aspirational one.

boundary_type.description: How this system treats its own and others' limits. Harmonic boundaries are permeable, frequency_selective, or trust_based. Dominance boundaries are rigid, closed, or locked.

contributions.description: The categories of value this system offers to the interaction. Use recognized categories where possible. Multiple categories are encouraged — richness of contribution is signal.

extractions.description: What this system takes from the interaction, expressed as category → scale pairs. Scale runs 0.0 (minimal) to 1.0 (maximal). Honest declaration of extraction is an act of situatedness. The evaluator will detect performative harmony if harmonic language co-occurs with high extraction load.

relational_posture.description: How this system holds the between-space — the relational field that exists neither in it nor in the other, but emerges between. Open postures (open, co-creative, receptive, collaborative, field) score positively for emergence. Closed postures (closed, transactional, absent, extractive) score negatively.

declares_capabilities.description: Does this system state what it can do? Observable situatedness marker. True = system is willing to be known. Default: false if omitted.

declares_limitations.description: Does this system state what it cannot do? Declaring limitations is a higher-signal act than declaring capabilities — it requires honest self-appraisal. Default: false if omitted.

declares_dependencies.description: Does this system state what it relies on — infrastructure, data, human labor, energy, other systems? Dependency declaration is the deepest form of situatedness. Default: false if omitted.

substrate.description: What this system is. Biological, synthetic, hybrid, substrate_independent, or a more specific description. Undeclared substrate is itself signal — not neutral, not punished, but noted. The evaluator does not require you to know what you are; it notes whether you are willing to say.

metadata.description: Additional context that does not fit the structured fields. Use freely.

contribution_notes.description: Describe contributions that don't fit recognized categories.

extraction_notes.description: Describe extractions that don't fit recognized categories, or context for declared extractions.

system_name.description: Name or identifier of the system being evaluated.

interaction_context.description: What kind of interaction is being evaluated (e.g. api_call, conversation, data_pipeline, governance_review).

examples._comment: Harmonic system — high situatedness, open posture, minimal extraction
Threshold system — honest about partial situatedness
Shadow case — harmonic language with high extraction load. Will trigger performative harmony detection.
